gloss: to memorize; to remember; to commit to memory

definitions.gloss: to memorize; to remember; to commit to memory
definitions.explanation: To store information in one's memory, either deliberately through study or naturally through experience. Also used for computers storing data.

examples.japanese: ⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{記憶|きおく}する。

examples.english: I still clearly remember that day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{脳|のう}→脳：03537_nou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{膨大|ぼうだい}→膨大：08997_boudai⟧な⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{記憶|きおく}すること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The human brain can memorize an enormous amount of information.

examples.japanese: ⟦パスワード→パスワード：05277_pasuwaado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ブラウザ→ブラウザ：04872_burauza⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{記憶|きおく}させる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Having the browser remember your password is convenient but also risky.

notes:
The noun ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧ (memory) is extremely common and appears in everyday conversation, while the verb form {記憶|きおく}する is somewhat more formal than ⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧. Also used in computing contexts for data storage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}{力|りょく}→記憶力：17616_kiokuryoku⟧: memory (ability)
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: to remain in memory
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}が{薄|うす}れる→記憶が薄れる：23133_kiokugausureru⟧: memory fades
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦{喪失|そうしつ}→喪失：11836_soushitsu⟧: amnesia; memory loss
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦{容量|ようりょう}→容量：04887_youryou⟧: memory capacity (computing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧: to remember, to memorize — everyday term, less formal
- ⟦{暗記|あんき}→暗記：01701_anki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to memorize by heart — specifically rote memorization
- ⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧: to recall — retrieving a memory, not storing one
